findings.evidence: Step 1.1 applies the removable-singularity theorem to f|_{\mathbb D\setminus\{0\}} even though f is already holomorphic on all of \mathbb D, so no new extension is produced. Step 2.1's case split on F(0) therefore does not prove impossibility; the standard contradiction must instead use the inverse map on the punctured disc.
